{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out rows where customer_age == -1 (sentinel for missing data)
df_filtered = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute and print the number of valid rows and the mean age
n_valid = len(df_filtered)
mean_age = df_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of valid customer_age entries: {n_valid}")
print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding sentinel -1 values): {mean_age}")"}
